turns.text: Hey Deborah, how's it going? Guess what? Yesterday my partner and I got back from an awesome trip to Rio de Janeiro- we checked out some cool yoga classes.
That yoga pose looks great. Must've been a cool experience for the two of you. What did the trip teach you?

This country was awesome! It showed me different kinds of yoga and their backgrounds, which made me appreciate it even more. We visited a lot of delicious cafes! Have you ever been somewhere that was important to you?

Yep, last month I visited my mom`s house which holds a special place in my heart. My mom had good and bad times there, but it's still a symbol of her strength and the love she shared with me. This is my husband in front of this house.
What was it like?
It brought back fond memories as I relaxed outside.
Sounds great! So glad you have a place to relax and find peace.
Thanks, Jolene. It's special for me. How about you? Is there a place that helps you relax?
I go to this nearby place to meditate by a tranquil spot.
Looks chill. What's been the effect of that?
It helps me make sense of everything and relieves stress. It's like a restart.
Cool, glad you found a place to chill. We all need that occasionally. This is one of my favorite spots to ponder and let things go.
Looks great! What made you pick that spot?
The soothing vibes and nice views made it ideal for reflecting and letting go.
Here is one more photo from Rio de Janeiro. We went on many excursions there.
Wow, those stairs look cool! Where were they taken?
We had a great time visiting an old temple. The stairs were amazing!
Wow, exploring those temples must have been incredible! Three years ago I was also in Rio de Janeiro, I took a beautiful photo on one of the excursions.
The architecture and history of it all were really interesting. I'm sure you also liked the places you visited there!
Exploring historical places and learning their stories is so fun. It was a great experience. I want to share this photo with you.
By the way, what did that paper have written on it in the photo?
This was written to me by a friend who, unfortunately, will never be able to support me. I miss him here. This quote says"Let go of what no longer serves you."
I'm sorry! That's a good reminder to stay focused and let go of what no longer serves us. Remember the quote in my notebook? It also inspires me!
What other quotes give you strength?
I came across this one while browsing and it really hit home with me. It's a great reminder to ditch the negative stuff and focus on growing and being positive.
Surrounding ourselves with good stuff and striving to improve is key.
Yep, Deborah! It's about creating a good atmosphere to help us grow and improve. By the way, I have a new plant.
What made you pick it?
I got this as a reminder to nurture myself and embrace fresh starts.
Nice job, Jolene! Take care of yourself and embrace new beginnings.
Thanks Deb! Will do. Good talking to you. Take care!
Have a great day!
